title: Subscribed (internet) calendars disappear
creator: clay8
content: I have added a subscribed calendar to Thunderbird using an URL. It is a public calendar. It shows in my calendar when added, When I exist and come back to Thunderbird later, the calendar still shows in the list but all of the appointments/events are missing. It I remove the calendar and re-add, still no appointments/events. A new install of Thunderbird produces the same results.

title: how to send reply in same format as received email
creator: harrischrisa
content:
I am using Thunderbird as an email client. I have the option set to normally send emails as plain text. If I receive an email that is formatted and then reply, the email is composed as unformatted. I wan the reply to be formatted.

Is there anyway Thunderbird can detect formatting and automatically format the reply the same as received?

How can I reply to an already formatted email so that the reply is formatted?
